text:
Samir: Quick idea — after the last outage I sketched a short remediation ownership roadmap we could try. TL;DR: 1) 48h owner assignment, 2) 2-week remediation window with tracked checkpoints, 3) recurring pattern watch. Proposal below.

Ellie: Can you paste the template here?

Samir: Sure — rough template:```
owner: <name>
due: YYYY-MM-DD
priority: P0/P1
remediation-type: bugfix/infra/process
check-ins: 48h, 7d, 14d
metrics: error-rate, latency-p50
rollback-risk: low/medium/high
customer-impact: none/minor/major
blocked-by: <issue-id>
next-step: short description
status: todo/in-progress/done
```

Jamie: :thumbsup: Add "rollback-risk" and "customer-impact" — good call. Also recommend an owner contact method (pager/email).

Maria: We should automate the reminders. incident-bot can DM owners at 48h and 7d if we tag the doc. ops-bot can post a daily digest to #incidents.

incident-bot: scheduled reminder created: will DM owners at 48 hours and 7 days after owner assignment.

ops-bot: I can post an automated daily digest of open remediations at 09:00 UTC. Need a label field in the template so I can filter (e.g., "open-remediation:true").

Lina: For IC rotation: propose 2-week ICs, opt-in list, swap day Monday morning handoff. Keep rotation separate from the on-call pager roster.

Tom: Also tie outstanding remediation items to postmortem closure. If a remediation blocks closure, mark pm-blocker:true so the postmortem stays open and gets visibility.

Samir: Plan: I'll add this template to the incident runbook as a minimal form + checklist. Steps: create PR by EOD with template + instructions; ops to wire bot reminders; add an initial IC rotation page.

Ellie: +1. Can we make owner default to last committer or owning service team to speed assignment?

Jamie: Schedule a 30-min sync next Wed to finalize the fields and runbook flow. I propose 10:30am PT.

Maria: Works for me.

Samir: Great — I'll open the PR and ping this thread when it's ready. After we test bot reminders on one real remediation we'll iterate. Thanks all.
